product.faq1Q: How long does a gem last?
product.faq1A: Applied correctly, six to twelve months. The bond is reversible and leaves the enamel intact.
product.faq2A: No. The gem is bonded to the enamel with a dental adhesive: nothing is drilled or filed.
product.faq3A: We sell to trained artists. The Foundation course covers prep, application and aftercare.

academy.title:
Training that holds up
in the chair
academy.body: Prep, application, removal and aftercare. Videos in FR · EN · DE, validation quizzes and a professional certificate at the end of the track.
academy.communityBody: Every module ends with a case review: you send in photos of your work, a trainer replies within 48h. Certified artists then appear in the public directory.
academy.toastEnrollBody: The Foundation course has been added to your artist account.
academy.accountRequired: An account is required to take a course.

training.heroCardItem3: The notes and cards for every lesson
training.heroImageAlt: Close-up of a tooth gem application
training.expTitle: A training you live through, not a playlist of videos
training.expLead: Five moments, from the first anatomy landmark to validating what you know.
training.exp1Body: Enamel anatomy, workspace hygiene and the vocabulary of the craft, before touching a gem.
training.exp2Body: Every motion is filmed in close-up, then repeated in slow motion.
training.exp3Body: You move at your own pace and replay a lesson as many times as you need.
training.exp4Body: The recommended procedures: preparation, application, inspection, client advice, removal.
training.exp5Body: The validation questions cover the most common mistakes, with the explanation each time.
training.outcomesTitle: What you'll be able to do afterwards
training.outcomesLead: The skills the {{count}} lessons of this curriculum are built around.
training.outcome1: Read enamel anatomy and what it allows.
training.outcome2: Set up a clean workspace and a compliant field.
training.outcome3: Choose the gem and its position on the tooth.
training.outcome4: Etch, rinse and dry enamel with the right timings.
training.outcome5: Apply the gem and run the two-stage cure.
training.outcome6: Inspect the finish, then advise the client.
training.outcome7: Remove a gem without damaging enamel.
training.curriculumLead: {{modules}} modules, {{lessons}} lessons, {{duration}} of video. Expand a module to see what's inside.
training.modulePreviewAria: Lesson available as a free preview
training.moduleValidationSummary: The training's validation questions — replay them as many times as you need to reach the required score.
training.journeyLead: Five steps, always in the same order.
training.journey1Body: Follow the modules at your own pace, one lesson at a time.
training.journey2Body: Rehearse the motions between lessons, notes in hand.
training.journey4Body: Review the ones you missed, read why, then try again.
training.journey5Body: Reach the required score: the training is validated and the diploma issued.
training.quizLead: The validation questions are there to confirm what you know. Replay them as often as you like: the goal is mastery, not a verdict.
training.quizReassure: Didn't get it right first time? That's fine. We explain why, you try again, your score goes up.
training.quizMeterAria: Example progress: {{score}}% against a required score of {{required}}%
training.quizPoint1Body: A missed question can be replayed. Nothing locks, nothing is lost.
training.quizPoint2Body: The feedback says why the right answer is right — that's where the learning happens.
training.quizPoint3Body: As soon as you reach {{score}}%, the training is validated.
training.quizSampleNote: A question from the Application module, exactly as it appears in the player.
training.diplomaTitle: Finish the training, leave with your diploma
training.diplomaLead: The Global Toothgems diploma is awarded once the training is complete and the required score is reached.
training.diplomaPoint3: Issued in your name, dated and referenced
training.diplomaPoint4: Available in your account at any time
training.diplomaDocAria: Preview of the diploma awarded for “{{title}}”
training.communityLead: Buying a training opens access to the artist forum: a space between practitioners to talk technique, good practice and the cases you actually meet.
training.communityThread1Title: What's your favourite technique for lateral teeth?
training.communityThread2Title: My first results, two weeks after the training
training.communityThread3Title: Which good practices have stayed with you?
training.communityThread4Title: Need advice on a tricky removal
training.communityPreviewNote: Preview: the forum isn't included in this prototype.

steps.title: Shop
steps.body: Make a qualifying purchase of €20 or more.

faq.question: What counts as a qualifying purchase?
How much do I need to spend?
faq.answer: €20 or more on a single order earns one stamp.

faq.question: How do I collect stamps?
faq.answer: Each qualifying order adds one stamp to your card, which you will find in your member area.

faq.question: What happens after 5 stamps?
faq.answer: Your card is complete and unlocks 10% off your next order.

faq.question: When can I use my 10% reward?
faq.answer: On your next order, once your card is complete.

faq.question: Can I earn a stamp on every order?
faq.answer: Every order of €20 or more earns one stamp.
